description: outlier_threshold=0.40 — at 0.50 threshold, MAPE worsened slightly (0.4295 vs 0.4256) while R2 improved, suggesting over-filtering. At 0.40, should catch the most extreme dips (e.g., month 15 at 823 bbl is 44% of median) while keeping borderline points like month 5 (1834 bbl is 49% of median).
